notes: GAAP. Receipts/disbursements: governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); business-type from the Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Combined Utilities column (p7; Internal Service fund column excluded as governmental activities). Business-type receipts/disbursements totals are not printed as single totals; computed. Inception of Lease 140,707 recorded as debt_proceeds; Proceeds from Sale of Land Held for Resale 35,606 as other_financing. The nonmajor combining page (p13) labels a 107,741 line 'Payment to Refunded Bond Escrow Agent' but p15 shows it as Issuance of Lease, so lease inception is used. Governmental net transfers out (275,430) equal business-type net transfers in (p7). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column (component unit excluded). I read total assets as 248,635,180 which balances (and equals the sum of the lines); the governmental column total likewise computes to 96,449,288. Interfund Balances line nets to nil in Total column and is skipped. ending_cash = Cash and Cash Equivalents in the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4); certificates of deposit 251,360 and investments 16,849,081 (ending_investments) are separate. beginning_cash not shown. Proprietary cash flow statement p8 (net lines used); p9 is its operating-income reconciliation (nothing recorded). Detail: budgetary-basis schedules (budget and actual, final budget = original) are recorded for every fund that has one (p10 General; p15-20 nonmajor special revenue funds; p21 Debt Service; p22 capital projects); actuals are on the budget basis and differ slightly from the GAAP statements (e.g. GF revenue 10,815,183 vs 10,532,137). The GAAP nonmajor combining pages (p11-13: W 29th & Hwy 77 TIF through Misc Projects) duplicate funds covered by the budget schedules and are not recorded, except the South Sioux City Community Foundation column (p12), which has no budget schedule. The find_pages v8 re-trim added report pp76-77 (combining, p11-12) and pp91-92 (budget schedules for Police Pension, Wireless 911, Economic Development Sales Tax, Public Safety Sales Tax, Northeast Redevelopment Area TIF, p18-19), now recorded; nonmajor budget-basis detail revenue is now about 8.65M vs GAAP nonmajor total 8,529,845 (p13). Harvest Meadows Area TIF and Marina Inn TIF schedule (report p93, p20) has no revenue section (both funds show no revenue on the GAAP combining pages). p12, p16, p17 and p19 are continuation pages without row labels; labels taken from the facing page's row order. No utility budget schedules are in the trimmed PDF. Pages 23-28 are statistical tables (not recorded). Read pages 1-28 of 28.
